caption: The drawing depicts two renderings of the same object, which resembles a vintage lantern or lamp. The primary lantern, occupying the upper central position, is detailed with a predominantly black and gold exterior. Its round, glass front features an etched leaf or floral design. The lantern has a cylindrical projection at the bottom and a flat, round, gold-colored top with a series of small vent holes. There are rectangular, glass side panels with gold or brass frames, each etched with geometric or linear designs. Below and to the left of the main object is a faded, less-detailed version of the same lantern. This secondary depiction is mostly gray with light yellow outlines and lacks the detailed pattern seen in the main version. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige. Near the lower right corner, the name "Stanley Mazur" is written in small, neat, reddish lettering.
title: Carriage Lamp
